approach: Static recompilation of the XBE to C with xboxrecomp; NV2A pushbuffers drawn by a Direct3D 11 back end with the CPU rasteriser as fallback; a virtual Steel Battalion controller played from a pad and the keyboard
help: Shadow maps and float depth on the GPU (the cockpit runs at 5-7 fps)
Hand-testing the pad and keyboard mapping
Passthrough for a real Steel Battalion controller
notes: Pre-alpha. Campaign reaches Mission 00: the cockpit start-up, walking, the main monitor's view and combat work, and the mission plays through to the story scenes. Not playable yet: 5-7 fps in the cockpit, and the controls have only been driven by script.
